records.jp: ここって、聖イネス学園の教会？
records.en_original: Is this...the St. Ines Academy chapel?
records.en: Is this...the St. Ines Academy chapel?

records.jp: フラグメントの破片、こんなところに……
records.en_original: There's a Fragment shard in a place like this?
records.en: There's a Fragment shard in a place like this?

records.jp: 二人とも、早速触れてみて
records.en_original: Both of you, try touching it right away.
records.en: Both of you, try touching it right away.

records.jp: ……ここは、私にとってあまり心地のいい場所じゃない
records.en_original: This place gives me a bad feeling...
records.en: ...This isn't a very comfortable place for me.

records.jp: 私は駒川さんたちに捕まってここに連れてこられ、<CR>陽桜莉をおびき寄せるための人質にされた
records.en_original: Uta and the others caught me and brought me here as a hostage to draw you out, Hiori.
records.en: Komagawa-san and the others caught me<CR>and brought me here as a hostage to draw you out, Hiori.

records.jp: あの時、紫乃たちは陽桜莉のフラグメントを使い、<CR>コモンの扉を開こうとしていたからだ
records.en_original: Shino and the others were trying to use your Fragment to open a gate to the Common.
records.en: Shino and the others were trying to use your<CR>Fragment to open a gate to the Common.

records.jp: 結果としてそれは失敗に終わったけれど……
records.en_original: In the end, their plan failed.
records.en: In the end, their plan failed.

records.jp: 戦いの中で、モモさんのフラグメントが<CR>壊されてしまった
records.en_original: But during the fight, Momo's Fragment wound up getting broken.
records.en: During the fight, Momo-san's Fragment<CR>was destroyed.

records.jp: 私が人質にさえならなければ、<CR>こんなことにはならなかったはずなのに……
records.en_original: If only I hadn't let myself be captured, none of that would've happened...
records.en: If only I hadn't been taken hostage,<CR>none of this would've happened...

records.jp: 話せばきっとわかってもらえる。<CR>私は最後までそう信じていた
records.en_original: I truly believed we might understand each other if we talked it out.
records.en: I believed until the very end that if we talked,<CR>they would understand.

records.jp: 私のフラグメントを抜こうとしていたのは、<CR>お姉ちゃんだった
records.en_original: But the one who tried to take my Fragment...was my own sister.
records.en: But the one who tried to take my Fragment<CR>was Onee-chan.

records.jp: 私を苦しめないためというお姉ちゃんの言葉を……、<CR>その時の覚悟を、私はわかっていなくて
records.en_original: I was torn over her saying it was all so I wouldn't have to suffer. I didn't understand what lengths she was willing to go to back then.
records.en: I didn't understand what Onee-chan meant when she said<CR>she only wanted to spare me the pain, or what she'd resolved to do.

records.jp: 話し合いで解決しようとしていた私は、<CR>本当にバカだった……
records.en_original: I was really naive to think we could solve it all by talking it out.
records.en: I was really naive to think we could solve<CR>it all by talking it out.

records.jp: モモさんは、そんな私の身代わりになったせいで、<CR>フラグメントを壊された
records.en_original: Momo's Fragment was destroyed because she took my place.
records.en: Momo-san's Fragment was destroyed<CR>because she took my place.

records.jp: そして何カ月も、病院のベッドで<CR>眠ったままになってしまった
records.en_original: She remained unconscious in a hospital bed for months after that.
records.en: She remained unconscious in a hospital<CR>bed for months after that.

records.jp: あの時、仁菜ちゃんも言ってた。<CR>お姉ちゃんを苦しめているのは私でしかない、って
records.en_original: Niina said it at the time: I'm the only one causing my sister pain.
records.en: Niina-chan said it then too—<CR>that I was the only one causing Onee-chan pain.

records.jp: 中途半端な気持ちで話し合いを望んでいた私を、<CR>仁菜ちゃんが怒るのは当然だったと思う
records.en_original: I thought I could solve everything with half-hearted feelings, so of course Niina got mad at me.
records.en: I thought I could solve everything with half-hearted feelings,<CR>so of course Niina-chan got mad at me.

records.jp: あの時、お姉ちゃんは私ではなく、<CR>新しい世界を創ろうとする紫乃ちゃんを選んだ
records.en_original: That's why my sister chose to go with Shino's plan to create a new world instead of listening to me.
records.en: Back then, Onee-chan chose Shino-chan's plan<CR>to create a new world over me.

records.jp: 最後の最後まで、私のことを守るために。<CR>前の世界で起きたことを、繰り返さないように……
records.en_original: She protected me to the very end, so what happened in the previous world wouldn't happen again.
records.en: She protected me to the very end,<CR>so what happened in the previous world wouldn't happen again.

records.jp: それくらいの覚悟が、私にも必要だったんだよ
records.en_original: I could've used that kind of resolve.
records.en: I needed that kind of resolve too.

records.jp: 陽桜莉の言葉は、何も間違ってはいない
records.en_original: You're not wrong at all.
records.en: You're not wrong at all.

records.jp: けれど、言葉だけで想いを変えるような、<CR>中途半端な気持ちでリフレクターになった子はいない
records.en_original: But no one who's become a Reflector is so half-hearted that they would waver at mere words.
records.en: But no one who's become a Reflector<CR>is so half-hearted that they would waver at mere words.

records.jp: わかってたのに、ちゃんと理解してなかった。<CR>陽桜莉も、私も……
records.en_original: I knew that, but I didn't really understand how she felt. Neither of us did.
records.en: We knew that, but we didn't truly understand it.<CR>Neither Hiori nor I did...

records.jp: 今の私は、どうなんだろう……
records.en_original: I wonder if I understand her now...
records.en: What about me now, I wonder...?

records.jp: 大切なものを守るための覚悟を、<CR>私は、持てているんだろうか？
records.en_original: Will I ever really have the resolve to protect what's important to me?
records.en: Do I have the resolve<CR>to protect what's important to me?

records.jp: みんなの想いを守るために……
records.en_original: To protect everyone's feelings...
records.en: To protect everyone's feelings...

records.jp: この世界を守るために……
records.en_original: And to protect this world.
records.en: And to protect this world.

records.jp: うっ……
records.en_original: Ugh...
records.en: Ugh...

records.jp: くっ……
records.en_original: Ngh...
records.en: Ngh...

records.jp: 陽桜莉ちゃん、瑠夏ちゃん、どうしたの！？
records.en_original: Hiori, Ruka, what's wrong?!
records.en: Hiori-chan, Ruka-chan, what's wrong?!

records.jp: う、ううん、なんでもない……。<CR>ちょっと、何か思い出したような……
records.en_original: It's nothing... I just feel like I remembered something.
records.en: It's nothing...<CR>I just feel like I remembered something.

records.jp: 思い出したって、何を？
records.en_original: Remembered what exactly?
records.en: Remembered what exactly?

records.jp: ……わからない。<CR>もうちょっとだったような気がするんだけど
records.en_original: I'm not sure. Whatever it was, though, I feel like I was just about to figure it out.
records.en: I'm not sure. Whatever it was,<CR>though, I feel like I was just about to figure it out.

records.jp: 何か、黒いものが頭の中に広がってきて
records.en_original: Some dark feeling is spreading inside my head.
records.en: Some dark feeling is spreading inside my head.

records.jp: それは……フラグメントがまだ黒い力に<CR>覆われているせい
records.en_original: That's because the Fragments are still bound by that dark energy.
records.en: That's because the Fragments are still bound<CR>by that dark energy.

records.jp: 完全に取り払わない限りは、<CR>今みたいに二人の想いに干渉し続けると思う
records.en_original: Unless it's completely gone, it'll keep interfering with your feelings like this.
records.en: Unless it's completely gone,<CR>it'll keep interfering with your feelings like this.

records.jp: このモヤモヤした感じが続くのは、<CR>あまりいい気分がしない
records.en_original: It feels awful. I'm not sure how well I'll hold up if this continues.
records.en: I don't like this hazy feeling lingering.<CR>It's making me uneasy.

records.jp: だね。フラグメントをしっかり直して、<CR>想いの力を元に戻さないとだし
records.en_original: Same here. We need to fix the Fragments and restore their original emotional power.
records.en: Same here. We need to fix the Fragments<CR>and restore their original emotional power.

records.jp: ライム……陽桜莉ちゃんたち、大丈夫なのかな？
records.en_original: Lime...do you think Hiori and the others will be okay?
records.en: Lime...do you think Hiori-chan and the others will be okay?

records.jp: やったことがないからわからない。<CR>けど、フラグメントの修復が進んでいるのは事実
records.en_original: This is my first time dealing with this, so I don't know. But their Fragments do need to be repaired.
records.en: We've never done this before, so I don't know.<CR>But their Fragments are definitely being restored.

records.jp: 私たちができるのは、最後まで見守ること。<CR>それくらいしかできないんだし
records.en_original: All we can do is watch over them until they get it done.
records.en: All we can do is watch over them<CR>until they get it done.
